notes.title: Tweaks and More Languages!
notes.content:
Hello Kings, we added a few things to the game:

[list]
[*] [b]More languages. すげえ![/b]: Japanese, Chinese, German, French, Russian, Spanish

[*] [b]More Visbility for the droppable Ball[/b]
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743877/e7844280394783bff880b79a57b375950b70a5b6.png[/img]

The droppable Ball now has a white Glow and the Balls in the Background fade out when they're close to the Ball Pit. This should make it easier to see at a glance what kind of Ball you're about to drop.

We're looking forward to your feedback and best of luck getting those King Balls!

Thank you for Playing
The BPK3D Team

notes.title: Small Fix
notes.content: Fixed a bug where the placeable balls were not unlocked on the first game.

notes.title: BALL PIT KING 3D NOW RELEASED!
notes.content:
[b]BALL PIT KING 3D is now available with a 40% discount for the first week![/b] 

Thanks to everyone who put the game on their wishlist and we hope you enjoy the game as much as we enjoyed the development of this charming little puzzle game.

Challenge your friends with the Scoreboard and good luck getting the gigantic King Ball! It's challenging but definitely doable. Now getting two Kings... also possible! Right?

Let us know your highscores, highlights and what kind of content you want to see in the future.

Have fun with the game and thank you for playing!

The BPK3D Team
